implementation.single_read_exact_pass: The exact loader now walks current-to-oldest generations once through the existing strict generation validator. It keeps only SHA-256 summaries of compact base events/head-manifest/identity state plus output-bearing tail segment rows, then reconstructs oldest-to-current and runs the complete canonical legacy validator.
implementation.memory_shape: The loader does not cache all decoded checkpoints. Retained compact summaries are constant-size apart from tail rows that belong to the returned exact history; checkpoint event populations and identity capsules are released generation by generation.
implementation.semantic_preservation: Checkpoint cycles, HEAD/checkpoint/segment bindings, storage markers, damage taxonomy, compact base identities, generation counts/tips, final event/manifest conservation, research-only ceilings, and default-off validation remain fail closed.
implementation.paired_fixture: The regression persists the same deterministic five-manifest logical history and final compact zero-tail tip with rotation depths 1, 2, and 4. Only rotation placement and derived retained archive bytes vary.
implementation.honest_ceiling: The guard freezes physical record visits and an affine tracemalloc envelope for a small deterministic fixture. It does not prove real market-scale memory, RSS, latency, cadence, or SLO. Whole rotation still performs separate pre-commit and post-commit validation phases and remains explicit and unscheduled.

telemetry_notes.read_invariant: Hot reads exactly HEAD plus current checkpoint once. Exact reads HEAD plus every reachable checkpoint and segment once; observed bytes equal the unique reachable file-size sum.
telemetry_notes.memory_guard: Peak must not exceed 4 MiB interpreter allowance plus 32 times the sum of read bytes and canonical output bytes. This is a conservative regression tripwire, not a capacity promise.
telemetry_notes.elapsed: Elapsed milliseconds were emitted by V2_SEGMENT_SCALE for diagnostics only and have no pass threshold.
telemetry_notes.external_tracer: If tracemalloc is already owned by the interpreter or a plugin, the test preserves it, emits peak_bytes=null, and skips only the allocator-specific peak assertion; record/byte/logical guards still run.
